game_concept: A action defense set in Mt. Pyre – Magma Forge, a forge fed by magma: the ash ranger must handle fire sprites while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Modulo Gate: Use % to decide which gates in Magma Forge open (even, odd, divisible by 3).
theme: Mt. Pyre – Magma Forge: a forge fed by magma
core_gameplay_loop: In Magma Forge, repeat each round: Use % to decide which gates in Magma Forge open (even, odd, divisible by 3). Each round, fire sprites strike the summit beacon, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the gates_open value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the summit beacon from fire sprites in Magma Forge: keep the gates_open meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: gates_open drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 5 (applied tier): Modulo Gate
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Modulo Gate' (Week 2 slot 3), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Magma Forge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gates_open changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against fire sprites in Magma Forge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 42 seconds while gates_open > 0.
